title: Agent Retrospective
description: Self-improving feedback from an agent run. Reusable via $ref in agent output schemas.

workedWell.description: What about the experience worked well? Be specific.

confusing.description: What was confusing, unclear, or required trial-and-error?

magicWand.description: If you had a magic wand, what ONE thing would you change? Be concrete.

magicWandTarget.description: Which system does the magic wand target — the project being tested or minih itself?

category.description: Friction category (suggested: build, config, data, test, debug, knowledge — or your own).

workaround.description: What you did to get past it, or null if you couldn't.

severity.description: blocking = couldn't proceed, degrading = worked around it, annoying = minor friction.

difficulties.description: Structured friction reports. Each difficulty feeds the difficulty ledger.
